title: Miracles of Christ
definition: The miracles of Christ are His mighty works that reveal His identity, compassion, authority, kingdom power, and saving mission.
summary: Jesus' miracles reveal who He is and point to the kingdom of God.
christFocus: Christ's miracles display His authority over creation, sickness, demons, sin, and death.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus' miracles are signs, not entertainment. They reveal His identity and mission. He heals the sick, calms storms, feeds the hungry, casts out demons, raises the dead, and forgives sin.

The miracles show kingdom power breaking into a broken world. They point to the final restoration Christ will bring.

Yet miracles were never meant to replace faith in Christ. They call people to see, believe, worship, and follow Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People may chase miracles while missing Christ, or deny miracles and weaken the biblical witness. This doctrine matters because Christ's works reveal His authority and compassion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let the miracles lead you to worship Jesus. Pray boldly for God's help, but seek Christ Himself above signs.
